listingTitle: Avoid inserting at the front of Vec in loops
title: Avoid inserting at the front of Vec in loops
why: Vec::insert(0, value) shifts every existing element, so repeated front insertion can produce quadratic work.
suggestion: Append and reverse once when order permits, or use VecDeque and push_front when front insertion is required.
limitations: Only function-local variables explicitly typed or initialized as Vec and inserted at literal index zero inside braced loops are reported.
Aliases, collection size, loop bounds, and intentionally small vectors are not inferred.
